summary: Lucas GC Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 2, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time, alongside a proxy card. The EGM asks shareholders to ratify a 125-for-1 share consolidation effective September 1, 2026, reducing authorized capital from 2.5 billion shares at US$0.0002 par to 20 million shares at US$0.025 par, and to ratify amended articles reflecting that consolidation. No acquisition, tender, or capital return terms appear; this is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation. Watch for quorum and any reverse-split-driven trading adjustments.
